name: Soliera (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Soliera (a yellow sun on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Soliera, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by royal decree on 23 February 1862.

features.role: Soliera arms — yellow sun on blue, crowned, within branches
